item.title: Version 1.63
item.description:
What's new in 1.63

  • Onboarding and Settings now recommend base models, explaining that Typer handles personalisation through completion examples rather than instructions

item.title: Version 1.62
item.description:
What's new in 1.62

  • Add instruction-to-example compilation: writing style instructions are automatically compiled into few-shot completion examples in the background, bridging personalisation rules with base model pattern matching

item.title: Version 1.61
item.description:
What's new in 1.61

  • Add first-launch onboarding wizard
  • Step-by-step setup: Welcome → Permissions → Model → Done
  • Auto-opens on first launch; re-accessible via 'Set up Typer…' in the menu bar when setup is incomplete
  • Permissions step shows live grant status; model step includes HuggingFace browser and file picker

item.title: Version 1.60
item.description:
What's new in 1.60

  • App name and window title now included in LLM prompt for better contextual completions
  • Field placeholder text (e.g. 'Add a comment…') included in prompt when available
  • MidWordCharset guard rejects completions with garbage embedded symbols (e.g. control chars or $^|)

item.title: Version 1.59
item.description:
What's new in 1.59

  • Improved suggestion quality and placement from KeyType research

item.title: Version 1.58
item.description:
What's new in 1.58

  • Add language picker (General settings) to force completions in a specific language
  • Strip <|end_of_turn|> control token from model output (affects Llama 3.x and Gemma models)
  • Skip main-thread dispatch in event tap when Typer is disabled, reducing per-keystroke overhead
  • Fall back to window title as screen context when OCR returns sparse text

item.title: Version 1.55
item.description:
What's new in 1.55

  • Ghost text tracks the cursor more accurately — the overlay now remembers which positioning method works best for each app, fixing misalignment in Gmail, Outlook, and ProseMirror editors
  • When you type through a suggestion character by character, the ghost text updates instantly rather than briefly showing the character you just typed as upcoming
  • Accepting the first word of a suggestion now hides the stale overlay immediately and re-shows at the correct position 4× faster than before

item.title: Version 1.54
item.description:
What's new in 1.54

  • Field-aware completions: Typer now detects what kind of field you're typing in (search bar, code editor, chat, document, URL bar) and adjusts completions accordingly — search and URL fields are excluded, code fields only complete inside comments and strings
  • Smarter candidate selection: before calling the model, Typer now ranks completions from cache, local word completion, and your personal style examples — the best one wins, often with no LLM round-trip
  • Adaptive latency: under load, Typer automatically reduces token budget and OCR timeout to keep completions fast
  • Quality filtering: completions with repeated words, unexpected capitalisation, or content already present to the right of the cursor are silently rejected

item.title: Version 1.48
item.description:
What's new in 1.48

  • Fix ghost text placement on external monitors (incorrect Y-coordinate flip when a display sits above the primary)
  • Reject bad caret rects from Chrome (oversized width), Outlook (stale left-edge), and Gmail (multi-line height union)
  • Find caret via ancestor elements in Chrome contenteditable where AXSelectedTextMarkerRange lives on a parent node
  • Fix child text run sort order so Gmail/Outlook caret position maps correctly in multi-paragraph editors
  • Derive ghost text font size from caret height in Chrome/web where AX font metadata is unavailable

item.title: Version 1.45
item.description:
What's new in 1.45

  • Add Typing Trace to debug panel
  • Records every suggestion shown, Tab/full acceptance (with exact inserted text and keyboard-buffer context at that moment), and dismissals in a 50-event ring buffer. Visible in Debug panel under 'Typing Trace' with Copy and Clear buttons. Also included in Copy Diagnostics output. Spaces rendered as · so rogue spaces are immediately visible.

item.title: Version 1.44
item.description:
What's new in 1.44

  • Fix double period when context already ends with punctuation
  • The sentence-break insertion now checks whether the context already ends with .?!,:; before adding '. ' — prevents 'Good morning.. How are you?' when the accepted word already carried a trailing period.

item.title: Version 1.43
item.description:
What's new in 1.43

  • Insert sentence period when suggestion is a capitalised question
  • Accepting 'How are you?' after 'Good morning' now produces 'Good morning. How are you?' instead of 'Good morning How are you?'. The normaliser uses '. ' as the word-boundary separator when the suggestion starts with an uppercase letter and ends with '?'.

item.title: Version 1.42
item.description:
What's new in 1.42

  • Fix pre-existing ContextCapture test failures and over-aggressive echo rejection
  • ContextCapture.keyboardBuffer is now internal so tests assert buffer state directly instead of going through the AX path. normalize() now strips context-echo prefixes and returns the continuation (e.g. context 'Good eve' + model 'Good evening' → 'ning') rather than rejecting.

item.title: Version 1.41
item.description:
What's new in 1.41

  • Fix suggestion rejected when model echoes context prefix
  • SuggestionTextNormalizer now strips the echoed context and uses the continuation rather than rejecting the whole response. Copy Diagnostics in debug panel now includes full untruncated live state data.

item.title: Version 1.40
item.description:
What's new in 1.40

  • Fix garbled text on suggestion acceptance
  • Strip typed fragment prefix at show time so acceptance is always a pure append — eliminates deletion timing bugs that caused corrupted output like 'liliclicenssinot valid'

item.title: Version 1.32
item.description:
What's new in 1.32

  • Validate Chrome and Confluence cursor-diff positions before placing suggestions so stale browser/sidebar detections are ignored.
  • Reposition final streaming suggestions using the latest validated cursor instead of keeping the first streaming location.
  • Document browser-editor context and cursor validation behavior in the README and troubleshooting notes.

item.title: Version 1.31
item.description:
What's new in 1.31

  • Increase the model prompt's nearby text window so suggestions can use more caret-relevant surrounding context.
  • Keep recent preceding paragraphs in the active prompt while capping old document text to avoid unrelated context drift.
  • Expand right-side caret context from 160 to 300 characters for better inline completions around existing text.

item.title: Version 1.30
item.description:
What's new in 1.30

  • Keep Confluence suggestions anchored to the detected cursor in Chrome and Edge instead of falling back to stale accessibility caret geometry.
  • Use surrounding Confluence text for suggestions only when the accessibility context matches the live typed buffer, falling back to typed context when Confluence reports text from elsewhere.
  • Reset cached cursor and context after caret-moving actions so suggestions do not reuse an old paragraph.

item.title: Version 1.29
item.description:
What's new in 1.29

  • Show Checking for updates in the menu and disable the update item while Sparkle is checking.
  • Defer manual Sparkle checks briefly so the update window opens reliably from the menu bar.

item.title: Version 1.28
item.description:
What's new in 1.28

  • Fix Confluence context capture in Chrome by ignoring stale AX context when it disagrees with the live typed buffer.
  • Fix Confluence overlay placement by preferring fresh cursor detection over unreliable Chrome AX caret geometry.

item.title: Version 1.27
item.description:
What's new in 1.27

  • Fix suffix completion acceptance so accepting suggestions like automatica + lly completes to automatically instead of replacing typed text.
  • Restore suggestions in Confluence on Google Chrome by only suppressing completions when the cursor is truly inside a word.
